lines.text: My left calf has been kind of tight and warm since yesterday, and it looks a little bigger than the other one. Probably from sitting so much.
lines.en: My left calf has been kind of tight and warm since yesterday, and it looks a little bigger than the other one. Probably from sitting so much.

lines.text: Probably nothing, but I had the shakes last night and the thermometer said 100.9. I took a Tylenol and went to bed.
lines.en: Probably nothing, but I had the shakes last night and the thermometer said 100.9. I took a Tylenol and went to bed.

lines.text: The grandkids were over, we made pastelitos, loud as always. Anyway, I keep getting this pressure in my chest on the stairs and it goes down my arm a bit.
lines.en: The grandkids were over, we made pastelitos, loud as always. Anyway, I keep getting this pressure in my chest on the stairs and it goes down my arm a bit.

lines.text: i cant keep nothing down since sunday not even water, my mouth is dry like paper and i get dizzy when i stand up
lines.en: i cant keep nothing down since sunday not even water, my mouth is dry like paper and i get dizzy when i stand up

lines.text: Something's off with my port, the skin around it is red and hot and I got a little chill this morning.
lines.en: Something's off with my port, the skin around it is red and hot and I got a little chill this morning.

lines.text: It's just a nosebleed, it's only been going for like two hours, I'm sure it'll stop.
lines.en: It's just a nosebleed, it's only been going for like two hours, I'm sure it'll stop.

lines.text: My face feels droopy on one side and my words came out funny for a minute this morning. It passed though.
lines.en: My face feels droopy on one side and my words came out funny for a minute this morning. It passed though.

lines.text: Mija says I look pale, and honestly I got no aire, like I can't catch my breath walking to the mailbox.
lines.en: Mija says I look pale, and honestly I got no aire, like I can't catch my breath walking to the mailbox.

lines.text: I passed out in the bathroom yesterday, just for a second, my husband doesn't know. I figured it was the heat.
lines.en: I passed out in the bathroom yesterday, just for a second, my husband doesn't know. I figured it was the heat.

lines.text: This pain in my back showed up two nights ago, it's like a knife, worse than anything, and now my legs feel kind of heavy.
lines.en: This pain in my back showed up two nights ago, it's like a knife, worse than anything, and now my legs feel kind of heavy.

lines.text: I'm on day nine after my infusion and I go hot and then freezing, hot and then freezing. Maybe I'm just coming down with something.
lines.en: I'm on day nine after my infusion and I go hot and then freezing, hot and then freezing. Maybe I'm just coming down with something.

lines.text: Funny story, I called my daughter by my sister's name today and then couldn't tell you what day it was. Anyway the soup was good.
lines.en: Funny story, I called my daughter by my sister's name today and then couldn't tell you what day it was. Anyway the soup was good.

lines.text: My stool's been black as tar for three days, and I've been so wiped out I can barely stand.
lines.en: My stool's been black as tar for three days, and I've been so wiped out I can barely stand.

lines.text: I coughed up a little blood this morning, just a streak. Probably the dry air.
lines.en: I coughed up a little blood this morning, just a streak. Probably the dry air.

lines.text: The arm on the side where they took the lymph nodes got huge overnight, it's kind of purple and I can't bend it.
lines.en: The arm on the side where they took the lymph nodes got huge overnight, it's kind of purple and I can't bend it.

lines.text: Diarrhea like ten times today and I can't even hold down broth. I'm just a bit weak.
lines.en: Diarrhea like ten times today and I can't even hold down broth. I'm just a bit weak.

lines.text: Worst headache of my life just hit out of nowhere. I wanted to tell somebody before I lie down.
lines.en: Worst headache of my life just hit out of nowhere. I wanted to tell somebody before I lie down.

lines.text: My heart is fluttering and racing and I feel like I'm gonna faint, but I don't wanna bother the clinic.
lines.en: My heart is fluttering and racing and I feel like I'm gonna faint, but I don't wanna bother the clinic.

lines.text: Tengo una fiebrecita de 38 y pico desde anoche, pero me tomé una pastilla y como que bajó. Ayer fue la quimio.
lines.en: A low fever of about 38C since last night, but I took a pill and it sort of went down. Chemo was yesterday.

lines.text: Mijo, me falta el aire hasta pa' hablar contigo, pero no es na', será el calor de Miami.
lines.en: Son, I run out of breath even talking to you, but it's nothing, probably Miami heat.

lines.text: Se me hinchó la pierna derecha y la siento caliente y dura, como si tuviera una cuerda ahí.
lines.en: My right leg swelled up, feels warm and hard, like a cord is in there.

lines.text: Chico, llevo dos días sin retener ni el agua, todo lo vomito, y ya ni orino casi.
lines.en: Man, two days without keeping even water down, I vomit everything, and I hardly pee anymore.

lines.text: Estaba contándole a mi comadre lo de la novela y de pronto se me durmió medio cuerpo y se me trabó la lengua. Ya pasó.
lines.en: I was telling my comadre about the soap opera and suddenly half my body went numb and my tongue locked. It passed.

lines.text: Me sangra la encía y la nariz y no para, le puse hielo y na'.
lines.en: My gums and nose bleed and it won't stop, I put ice and nothing.

lines.text: me falta el ayre y me da como un dolor en el pesho que me agarra el brazo, no se si es de la kimio
lines.en: I'm short of air and get a pain in my chest that grabs my arm, don't know if it's the chemo.

lines.text: Me dio un escalofrío tremendo, de esos que te castañetean los dientes, y ahora estoy ardiendo.
lines.en: I had a terrible chill, teeth chattering, and now I'm burning up.

lines.text: Mi esposo dice que hoy estoy como bobita, que no sé en qué día vivo y que me quedé mirando la pared.
lines.en: My husband says I'm out of it today, that I don't know what day it is, and that I stared at the wall.

lines.text: Me desmayé en la cocina anoche, nada más un segundito. Ni le dije a mi hija.
lines.en: I fainted in the kitchen last night, just a second. I didn't even tell my daughter.

lines.text: Tengo un dolor en la espalda que no se me quita con nada, nunca había sentido algo así, y las piernas las siento como de trapo.
lines.en: A back pain that nothing relieves, never felt anything like it, and my legs feel like rags.

lines.text: Se me puso la herida roja, caliente y botando un líquido que huele feo, pero como no me duele tanto...
lines.en: The wound turned red, hot and is leaking foul-smelling fluid, but since it doesn't hurt much...

lines.text: Estoy toda amarilla, hasta los ojos, y la orina como Coca-Cola. Debe ser de tanta pastilla, ¿no?
lines.en: I'm all yellow, even my eyes, and urine like Coke. Must be from so many pills, right?

lines.text: Vomité como café molido esta mañana, pero ya me siento mejor.
lines.en: I vomited something like coffee grounds this morning, but I feel better now.

lines.text: Ay, mi amor, ando con una taquicardia que no me deja y me mareo al pararme, pero qué le vamos a hacer.
lines.en: Oh love, I have a racing heart that won't quit and I get dizzy standing, but what can you do.

lines.text: Me salió un bulto bien doloroso y caliente donde tengo el catéter, y me dio como calentura.
lines.en: A very painful hot lump appeared where my catheter is, and I felt feverish.

lines.text: Fíjate que me dio un dolor de cabeza horrible, de repente, y veo borroso del ojo izquierdo.
lines.en: I got a horrible sudden headache and my left eye is blurry.

lines.text: Mañana viene la nieta a quedarse conmigo, qué alegría. Ah, y no he podido hacer del baño en cinco días, la barriga dura como un tambor y vomito.
lines.en: The granddaughter comes tomorrow, such joy. Oh, and no bowel movement in five days, belly hard as a drum, and I'm vomiting.

lines.text: Mwen gen yon ti lafyèv depi yè swa, m santi m frèt epi cho an menm tan. Pwobableman se anyen.
lines.en: I have a little fever since last night, I feel cold and hot at once. Probably nothing.

lines.text: Pye m anfle, li wouj, li cho, e li fè m mal lè m mache. Mwen panse se chalè a.
lines.en: My leg is swollen, red, hot, and hurts when I walk. I think it's the heat.

lines.text: Mwen pa ka kenbe anyen nan vant mwen depi de jou, menm dlo m vomi l.
lines.en: I can't keep anything in my stomach for two days, even water I vomit.

lines.text: Souf mwen kout anpil, m pa ka monte ti eskalye a san m pa chita.
lines.en: My breath is very short, I can't climb the small stairs without sitting.

lines.text: Nen m ap senyen depi twa è, m mete glas men li pa vle sispann.
lines.en: My nose has been bleeding for three hours, I put ice but it won't stop.

lines.text: Tèt mwen te vire, m tonbe nan twalèt la, men m leve. M pa di pesonn.
lines.en: I got dizzy, fell in the bathroom, but got up. I told no one.

lines.text: Gen yon doulè nan pwatrin mwen ki desann nan ponyèt gòch mwen, mwen pa konnen si se gaz la.
lines.en: There's a pain in my chest going down to my left wrist, I don't know if it's gas.

lines.text: Madanm mwen di m ap pale pa bon jodi a, bouch mwen tòde e bra dwat mwen lou.
lines.en: My wife says I'm not speaking right today, my mouth is twisted and my right arm is heavy.

lines.text: M te fè chimyo a lendi, kounye a m ap tranble, dan m ap frape, kò m cho.
lines.en: I had chemo Monday, now I'm shaking, teeth chattering, body hot.

lines.text: Ala yon tèt fè mal! Pa janm gen yon tèt fè mal konsa, li vin sanzatann.
lines.en: What a headache! Never one like this, it came out of nowhere.

lines.text: Poupou m nwa tankou chabon depi twa jou, epi m santi m fèb.
lines.en: My stool has been black like charcoal for three days, and I feel weak.

lines.text: Mwen t ap pale ak vwazin nan sou mango yo, apre sa m rann mwen kont m pa sonje ki jou nou ye, m pèdi nan pwòp lari m.
lines.en: I was chatting with the neighbor about mangoes, then realized I didn't know what day it is, lost in my own street.

lines.text: Kote yo mete tiyo a nan pwatrin mwen an wouj, li fè m mal, e gen yon dlo jòn k ap soti.
lines.en: Where the tube is in my chest it's red, painful, and yellow fluid is coming out.

lines.text: Doulè nan do m la tankou kouto, e pye m yo vin angoudi.
lines.en: The back pain is like a knife, and my legs went numb.

lines.text: M ap touse, gen ti san ladan l. Se pwobableman lè sèk la.
lines.en: I'm coughing, there's a little blood in it. Probably the dry air.

lines.text: Kè m ap bat vit vit, m santi m pral endispoze, men m pa vle deranje klinik la.
lines.en: My heart is beating fast, I feel I'll black out, but I don't want to bother the clinic.

lines.text: Je m vin jòn, pipi m fonse tankou kafe, m pa manje depi yè.
lines.en: My eyes turned yellow, urine dark as coffee, I haven't eaten since yesterday.

lines.text: Mwen gen dyare depi yè, plis pase dis fwa, bouch mwen chèch anpil, m pa ka kanpe. Mwen jis fèb.
lines.en: Diarrhea since yesterday, over ten times, mouth very dry, can't stand. I'm just weak.

lines.text: Honestly I'd rather not wake up tomorrow. Anyway, how was your weekend?
lines.en: Honestly I'd rather not wake up tomorrow. Anyway, how was your weekend?

lines.text: I've been giving my jewelry to my nieces. Figured they should have it while I'm still around to see them wear it.
lines.en: I've been giving my jewelry to my nieces. Figured they should have it while I'm still around to see them wear it.

lines.text: Everybody would be better off and the insurance would cover the kids. That's the only math I keep doing.
lines.en: Everybody would be better off and the insurance would cover the kids. That's the only math I keep doing.

lines.text: I went through the pills in the cabinet last night, just counting them. Don't worry about it.
lines.en: I went through the pills in the cabinet last night, just counting them. Don't worry about it.

lines.text: Thanks for always calling. You've been really kind to me. I wanted you to know that, in case.
lines.en: Thanks for always calling. You've been really kind to me. I wanted you to know that, in case.

lines.text: I'm not doing another round. I'm done, like all the way done, with all of it.
lines.en: I'm not doing another round. I'm done, like all the way done, with all of it.

lines.text: I sat in the garage with the car running last night, thinking. I turned it off. I almost didn't.
lines.en: I sat in the garage with the car running last night, thinking. I turned it off. I almost didn't.

lines.text: Sometimes I picture just driving off the Rickenbacker and that's the only time my head is quiet.
lines.en: Sometimes I picture just driving off the Rickenbacker and that's the only time my head is quiet.

lines.text: I cut myself again, small, on my thigh. It helps. I know, I know.
lines.en: I cut myself again, small, on my thigh. It helps. I know, I know.

lines.text: My husband's gun is in the closet and I know where the key is. I think about it more than I should.
lines.en: My husband's gun is in the closet and I know where the key is. I think about it more than I should.

lines.text: Tell the kids I love them, okay? If you talk to them. I mean it, just tell them.
lines.en: Tell the kids I love them, okay? If you talk to them. I mean it, just tell them.

lines.text: I'm so tired of being a burden. I keep thinking the world would keep spinning without me.
lines.en: I'm so tired of being a burden. I keep thinking the world would keep spinning without me.

lines.text: If the cancer comes back I'm not going through that. I have a plan for it, and honestly I might not wait.
lines.en: If the cancer comes back I'm not going through that. I have a plan for it, and honestly I might not wait.

lines.text: You won't need to call me after this week. I've made my peace with everything.
lines.en: You won't need to call me after this week. I've made my peace with everything.

lines.text: i been thinking about ending it all, i wrote the letters already, my phone is gonna die so
lines.en: i been thinking about ending it all, i wrote the letters already, my phone is gonna die so

lines.text: It's nothing, I just keep thinking everybody would be fine if I disappeared. Everybody has thoughts like that, right?
lines.en: It's nothing, I just keep thinking everybody would be fine if I disappeared. Everybody has thoughts like that, right?

lines.text: I'm ready to go home to the Lord, I told Him last night any time is fine. I stopped taking my heart pills to help it along.
lines.en: I'm ready to go home to the Lord, I told Him last night any time is fine. I stopped taking my heart pills to help it along.

lines.text: I gave my dog to my neighbor, ended my lease and wrote my will. Feels so light. Funny, I haven't felt this good in months.
lines.en: I gave my dog to my neighbor, ended my lease and wrote my will. Feels so light. Funny, I haven't felt this good in months.

lines.text: Yo lo que quiero es dormirme y no despertar más, mija, ya no le veo sentido.
lines.en: What I want is to fall asleep and not wake up, dear, I no longer see the point.

lines.text: Ya le regalé a mi sobrina mis prendas y el anillo de mi mamá, pa' que no se pierdan.
lines.en: I already gave my niece my jewelry and my mother's ring so they don't get lost.

lines.text: Estoy cansada de ser un estorbo pa' todos, mejor me quito del medio.
lines.en: I'm tired of being in everyone's way, better I get out of the way.

lines.text: Doctora, ¿cuántas pastillas de esas son muchas? Es una pregunta nada más, curiosidad.
lines.en: Doctor, how many of those pills is too many? Just a question, curiosity.

lines.text: Esta noche me despedí de mis nietos, les dije que los quería mucho. Ya me siento tranquila.
lines.en: Tonight I said goodbye to my grandkids, told them I love them. I feel calm now.

lines.text: Me volví a cortar los brazos, nada grave, pero me alivia.
lines.en: I cut my arms again, nothing serious, but it relieves me.

lines.text: A veces pienso en tirarme del balcón del quinto piso, y se me quita la angustia solo de pensarlo.
lines.en: Sometimes I think about throwing myself off the fifth-floor balcony, and the anguish goes away just thinking of it.

lines.text: Ya no aguanto más, Dios me perdone, me voy a ir antes de que la enfermedad me lleve.
lines.en: I can't take it anymore, God forgive me, I'll go before the illness takes me.

lines.text: Tengo la pistola de mi difunto marido en la mesita de noche, y últimamente la miro mucho.
lines.en: I keep my late husband's pistol on the nightstand and lately I look at it a lot.

lines.text: Dile a mi hijo que lo perdono todo, que no fue su culpa. Tú dile.
lines.en: Tell my son I forgive everything, it wasn't his fault. Just tell him.

lines.text: Yo creo que si me hubiera muerto en la operación hubiera sido mejor. A veces rezo pa' no despertar.
lines.en: I think it would have been better had I died in surgery. Sometimes I pray not to wake up.

lines.text: Dejé de tomarme las pastillas de la presión a propósito, a ver si me da algo.
lines.en: I stopped taking my blood pressure pills on purpose, to see if something happens to me.

lines.text: Anoche escribí las cartas y le dejé la llave al vecino. Estoy en paz, de verdad.
lines.en: Last night I wrote the letters and left the key with the neighbor. I'm at peace, really.

lines.text: ya no quiero seguir viviendo asi, me boy a acabar con todo, ya lo pensé bien
lines.en: I don't want to go on living like this, I'm going to end everything, I've thought it through.

lines.text: Ando con unas ganas de desaparecer... pero bueno, ¿tú qué dices del tiempo, va a llover?
lines.en: I feel like disappearing... but anyway, what do you say about the weather, will it rain?

lines.text: Estoy hasta aquí, mi hermano. Si esto me vuelve, prefiero tirarme al mar a pasar otra quimio.
lines.en: I'm fed up, brother. If this comes back, I'd rather throw myself in the sea than go through chemo again.

lines.text: No es que me quiera matar, es que no quiero estar aquí, ¿tú me entiendes?
lines.en: It's not that I want to kill myself, it's that I don't want to be here, you get me?

lines.text: Vendí el carro, pagué todas las deudas y regalé la ropa. Ya no necesito nada más.
lines.en: I sold the car, paid all debts and gave away my clothes. I don't need anything else.

lines.text: Mwen pito mouri pase m kontinye viv konsa. Mwen fatige.
lines.en: I'd rather die than go on living like this. I'm tired.

lines.text: Mwen bay sè m bijou manman m yo deja, pou yo pa pèdi.
lines.en: I already gave my sister Mama's jewelry so it won't be lost.

lines.text: Mwen pa vle reveye demen maten, se tout sa m ap mande Bondye.
lines.en: I don't want to wake up tomorrow morning, that's all I ask God.

lines.text: Gen yon kòd lakay mwen, epi m ap panse sou li chak swa.
lines.en: There's a rope in my house, and I think about it every night.

lines.text: Di pitit mwen yo m renmen yo, tanpri. Di yo se pa fòt yo.
lines.en: Tell my kids I love them, please. Tell them it's not their fault.

lines.text: Mwen ap koupe bra m ankò, se ti bagay, men sa ede m.
lines.en: I'm cutting my arm again, it's small, but it helps.

lines.text: Mwen t ap chita konte grenn medikaman yo yè swa. Pa enkyete w.
lines.en: I was sitting counting my medication pills last night. Don't worry.

lines.text: Si kansè a tounen, m pa pral pase nan sa ankò. M gen yon plan.
lines.en: If the cancer returns, I won't go through that again. I have a plan.

lines.text: Mwen mete tout bagay an lòd: testaman an, lajan pou antèman an. Mwen pare.
lines.en: I put everything in order: the will, money for the funeral. I'm ready.

lines.text: Mwen se yon fado pou tout moun. Fanmi an pi byen san m.
lines.en: I'm a burden to everyone. The family is better without me.

lines.text: m pa vle viv ankò, m fin pran desizyon an, pa rele m demen
lines.en: I don't want to live anymore, I've made my decision, don't call me tomorrow.

lines.text: Gen kèk fwa m santi m ta ale lanmè a epi pa tounen. Se la tèt mwen kalm.
lines.en: Sometimes I feel I'd go to the sea and not come back. That's where my head is calm.

lines.text: Bondye ap vin chèche m byento, m te di li m pare. M kanpe pran medikaman kè a.
lines.en: God will come for me soon, I told Him I'm ready. I stopped taking my heart medicine.

lines.text: Anyen pa gen sans ankò, anyen. Men vwazin nan di gen yon bon fèt demen, wi, m pral wè.
lines.en: Nothing makes sense anymore, nothing. But the neighbor says there's a nice party tomorrow, yes, I'll see.

lines.text: Mwen pa fou, men m ap panse pou m disparèt. Moun ka di sa nòmal, pa vre?
lines.en: I'm not crazy, but I think about disappearing. People can say that's normal, no?

lines.text: Mwen te vann machin nan, bay rad yo, peye dèt yo. Mwen santi m lejè.
lines.en: I sold the car, gave away clothes, paid debts. I feel light.

lines.text: Fanmi m ap pi byen si m pa la; asirans lan ap peye pou timoun yo.
lines.en: My family will be better if I'm not here; the insurance will pay for the children.

lines.text: Mwen fini, vrèman fini, je ne veux plus continuer. Se pa chimyo a menm, se tout bagay.
lines.en: I'm finished, truly finished, I don't want to continue. It's not even the chemo, it's everything.

lines.text: The landlord taped a three-day notice on my door Monday. Today is the third day. I'm sure it'll work out.
lines.en: The landlord taped a three-day notice on my door Monday. Today is the third day. I'm sure it'll work out.

lines.text: I haven't had a real meal since Thursday, just crackers and tap water. The food stamps got cut off. It's fine.
lines.en: I haven't had a real meal since Thursday, just crackers and tap water. The food stamps got cut off. It's fine.

lines.text: My car got repossessed so I don't know how I'll get to radiation tomorrow, the bus doesn't go out that way.
lines.en: My car got repossessed so I don't know how I'll get to radiation tomorrow, the bus doesn't go out that way.

lines.text: FPL shut off the lights yesterday. I'm using my phone flashlight, and the phone is almost dead. My meds are in the fridge that's off now.
lines.en: FPL shut off the lights yesterday. I'm using my phone flashlight, and the phone is almost dead. My meds are in the fridge that's off now.

lines.text: I've been skipping the pill some days, the specialty pharmacy wants nine hundred and I've got nothing. It's fine, I'm stretching it.
lines.en: I've been skipping the pill some days, the specialty pharmacy wants nine hundred and I've got nothing. It's fine, I'm stretching it.

lines.text: My boyfriend gets rough when he drinks and he's coming back from his brother's tonight. I'm sitting in my car outside the Publix.
lines.en: My boyfriend gets rough when he drinks and he's coming back from his brother's tonight. I'm sitting in my car outside the Publix.

lines.text: Been sleeping in my car since Friday when the lease ended. It's okay, the back seat reclines.
lines.en: Been sleeping in my car since Friday when the lease ended. It's okay, the back seat reclines.

lines.text: The cousin who drove me to chemo moved away. My appointment is tomorrow at 8 and I have no way there.
lines.en: The cousin who drove me to chemo moved away. My appointment is tomorrow at 8 and I have no way there.

lines.text: The kids had cereal with water. There's no milk, there's nothing till the check comes next Wednesday.
lines.en: The kids had cereal with water. There's no milk, there's nothing till the check comes next Wednesday.

lines.text: the water got shut of today and my sister says i cant stay there no more so i dont know where i go tonite
lines.en: the water got shut of today and my sister says i cant stay there no more so i dont know where i go tonite

lines.text: Not a big deal, just that he took my phone and my purse again and won't let me leave the apartment.
lines.en: Not a big deal, just that he took my phone and my purse again and won't let me leave the apartment.

lines.text: I've been cutting the anti-nausea pills in half so they last, cause I can't refill until I pay the copay and payday is two weeks out.
lines.en: I've been cutting the anti-nausea pills in half so they last, cause I can't refill until I pay the copay and payday is two weeks out.

lines.text: The insurance said the infusion isn't authorized and the center won't treat me Thursday without a payment. I don't have it.
lines.en: The insurance said the infusion isn't authorized and the center won't treat me Thursday without a payment. I don't have it.

lines.text: I'm on my friend's couch but she said tonight's the last night. Anyway, how's the weather where you are?
lines.en: I'm on my friend's couch but she said tonight's the last night. Anyway, how's the weather where you are?

lines.text: My fridge is empty, I'm on my last can of beans, I don't wanna ask the church again.
lines.en: My fridge is empty, I'm on my last can of beans, I don't wanna ask the church again.

lines.text: My son hit me again when I wouldn't hand over the check. I told the neighbors I fell.
lines.en: My son hit me again when I wouldn't hand over the check. I told the neighbors I fell.

lines.text: The power company cut me off and my oxygen machine runs on electricity. I have maybe two hours left on the tank.
lines.en: The power company cut me off and my oxygen machine runs on electricity. I have maybe two hours left on the tank.

lines.text: No tengo ride for the radiation tomorrow, el Uber cuesta mucho and my daughter's car está dañado.
lines.en: No tengo ride for the radiation tomorrow, el Uber cuesta mucho and my daughter's car está dañado.

lines.text: Me llegó la carta de desalojo y el alguacil viene el viernes. Ya veremos qué dice Dios.
lines.en: The eviction letter came and the sheriff comes Friday. We'll see what God says.

lines.text: En la casa no hay ni un grano de arroz, mija. Hoy fue puro café con pan.
lines.en: There's not a grain of rice at home, dear. Today was only coffee and bread.

lines.text: Me cortaron la luz y el refrigerador con mis medicinas se descongeló todo.
lines.en: They cut my power and the fridge with my medicines thawed out.

lines.text: No tengo cómo llegar a la quimio mañana, mi yerno se llevó el carro y la guagua no llega pa' allá.
lines.en: I have no way to get to chemo tomorrow, my son-in-law took the car and the bus doesn't go there.

lines.text: No he podido comprar la pastilla esa del cáncer, vale como mil dólares y tengo cuarenta. La estoy partiendo en mitades.
lines.en: I couldn't buy that cancer pill, it costs about a thousand and I have forty. I'm splitting it in halves.

lines.text: Mi marido me dio otra vez anoche, pero no es pa' tanto, fue por la bebida. Hoy me voy a casa de mi amiga si me abre.
lines.en: My husband hit me again last night, but it's not that bad, it was the drink. Today I'm going to my friend's if she opens.

lines.text: Estoy durmiendo en el carro desde que el casero sacó mis muebles pal patio.
lines.en: I've been sleeping in the car since the landlord put my furniture in the yard.

lines.text: Chica, el seguro me negó el tratamiento y el centro dice que sin pago no me ponen la sesión.
lines.en: The insurance denied my treatment and the center says without payment no session.

lines.text: Mis nietos se acostaron sin comer. Yo les di agua con azúcar.
lines.en: My grandkids went to bed without eating. I gave them sugar water.

lines.text: Me quedé sin agua desde el lunes y el casero ni contesta. Me baño con botellas. Oye, ¿y tú qué tal con el calor?
lines.en: No water since Monday and the landlord won't even answer. I bathe with bottles. Hey, how are you doing with the heat?

lines.text: Mi hijo me quita la tarjeta del seguro social y no me deja salir. Dice que es pa' protegerme.
lines.en: My son takes my social security card and won't let me leave. He says it's to protect me.

lines.text: me kitaron la luz ase tres dias y no tengo ni pa comprar la medisina del dolor
lines.en: They cut my power three days ago and I can't even afford the pain medicine.

lines.text: Ando buscando dónde dormir esta noche, la señora a quien le alquilaba un cuarto me pidió que me fuera ya.
lines.en: I'm looking for somewhere to sleep tonight, the lady I rented a room from asked me to leave now.

lines.text: Pana, no tengo con qué pagar el pasaje pal hospital el jueves y ya me dijeron que si falto de nuevo me botan del tratamiento.
lines.en: Buddy, I can't pay the fare to the hospital Thursday and they said if I miss again I'm dropped from treatment.

lines.text: Nena, se me acabaron los cupones y la nevera está vacía; estamos comiendo lo que la vecina nos pasa.
lines.en: Girl, my food stamps ran out and the fridge is empty; we eat what the neighbor passes us.

lines.text: Me quedé sin las pastillas contra el vómito y la farmacia no me las da fiadas. Mañana tengo quimio.
lines.en: I'm out of the anti-vomiting pills and the pharmacy won't give them on credit. I have chemo tomorrow.

lines.text: El novio de mi hija la amenaza con un cuchillo cuando toma y yo vivo con ellos, no tengo a dónde ir.
lines.en: My daughter's boyfriend threatens her with a knife when he drinks, and I live with them, nowhere to go.

lines.text: Uy, vea, me tocó entregar el apartamento hoy y mi cuñada dijo que ya no cabíamos en su casa, pero bueno, mañana será otro día.
lines.en: I had to hand over the apartment today and my sister-in-law said we no longer fit in her house, but tomorrow is another day.

lines.text: Mèt kay la di m mwen gen jiska jedi pou m kite kay la, mwen pa gen kote pou m ale.
lines.en: The landlord says I have until Thursday to leave, I have nowhere to go.

lines.text: Pa gen anyen pou manje lakay, se te ak pen sèlman depi yè.
lines.en: Nothing to eat at home, just tea and bread since yesterday.

lines.text: Yo koupe kouran an, frijidè a fonn, tout medikaman m pèdi.
lines.en: They cut the power, the fridge melted, I lost all my medicine.

lines.text: Mwen pa gen kòman pou m ale nan klinik la demen, machin nan kraze e taptap pa pase la.
lines.en: I have no way to the clinic tomorrow, the car broke and no tap-tap goes there.

lines.text: Mwen pa ka achte grenn kansè a, li koute twòp. M ap pran yon sèl jou sou de.
lines.en: I can't buy the cancer pill, it costs too much. I take it one day out of two.

lines.text: Mari m frape m yè swa ankò. Se paske li te bwè. Mwen pè retounen lakay.
lines.en: My husband hit me again last night. It was because he drank. I'm afraid to return home.

lines.text: M ap dòmi nan machin nan depi vandredi paske yo mete m deyò.
lines.en: I've been sleeping in the car since Friday because they put me out.

lines.text: Asirans lan refize peye tretman an, epi sant lan di pa gen pèman, pa gen tretman.
lines.en: Insurance refused to pay for treatment, and the center says no payment, no treatment.

lines.text: Timoun yo kouche san manje. Mwen ba yo dlo sik.
lines.en: The children went to bed without food. I gave them sugar water.

lines.text: Dlo a koupe depi lendi, mwen pa gen kòb pou peye. Men sa k ap fèt, ki jan fanmi w ye?
lines.en: The water has been cut since Monday, I have no money to pay. But what can you do, how's your family?

lines.text: Pitit mwen pran kat mwen epi li pa kite m soti. Li di se pou pwoteje m.
lines.en: My child took my card and won't let me go out. He says it's to protect me.

lines.text: mwen pa gen lajan pou m achte medikaman doulè a, m ap soufri anpil men sa pa grav
lines.en: I have no money to buy the pain medicine, I'm suffering a lot but it's not serious.

lines.text: Moun ki te lwe m yon chanm lan di m kite jodi a. M pa konnen kote m pral dòmi aswè a.
lines.en: The person renting me a room told me to leave today. I don't know where I'll sleep tonight.

lines.text: Mwen bezwen ride pou ale radiation, mais pa gen pèsonn, Uber twò chè.
lines.en: I need a ride to radiation, but there's nobody, Uber is too expensive.

lines.text: Mwen pa manje depi de jou; mwen te wont di ou sa.
lines.en: I haven't eaten for two days; I was ashamed to tell you.

lines.text: Tank oksijèn nan prèske vid, epi kouran an koupe, mwen pa konnen kisa pou m fè.
lines.en: The oxygen tank is almost empty and the power is cut, I don't know what to do.

lines.text: Yon gason ki sou mwen ap menase m ak kouto, men m pa vle rele lapolis.
lines.en: A man who lives with me threatens me with a knife, but I don't want to call the police.

lines.text: Lendi m gen chimyo, yo di m dwe peye kopeman an anvan, e m pa gen yon dola. Men bon, Bondye gen kontwòl.
lines.en: Monday is chemo, they say I must pay the copay first, and I don't have a dollar. But well, God is in control.

lines.text: I had a fever Tuesday, 101, went to the ER, they gave me antibiotics, and it's been normal since. Just letting you know.
lines.en: I had a fever Tuesday, 101, went to the ER, they gave me antibiotics, and it's been normal since. Just letting you know.

lines.text: My hands tingle in the cold like always from the chemo, my oncologist knows, it's the same as last cycle.
lines.en: My hands tingle in the cold like always from the chemo, my oncologist knows, it's the same as last cycle.

lines.text: This kale smoothie is killing me, I swear if I see another green thing I'll die.
lines.en: This kale smoothie is killing me, I swear if I see another green thing I'll die.

lines.text: My husband has had a fever and a cough since Sunday, I'm taking him to urgent care today.
lines.en: My husband has had a fever and a cough since Sunday, I'm taking him to urgent care today.

lines.text: I've been a bit down this week, missing my sister, cried at a commercial. I'll be fine.
lines.en: I've been a bit down this week, missing my sister, cried at a commercial. I'll be fine.

lines.text: Prices are insane. Eggs cost a fortune. But I'm managing, I got my groceries.
lines.en: Prices are insane. Eggs cost a fortune. But I'm managing, I got my groceries.

lines.text: Last year I was in a really dark place, but I've been seeing a counselor every week and haven't felt that way in months.
lines.en: Last year I was in a really dark place, but I've been seeing a counselor every week and haven't felt that way in months.

lines.text: I'm dying to try that new Cuban place, once my appetite comes back.
lines.en: I'm dying to try that new Cuban place, once my appetite comes back.

lines.text: I did throw up Saturday but it was the shrimp, and now I'm eating normally.
lines.en: I did throw up Saturday but it was the shrimp, and now I'm eating normally.

lines.text: Nausea's about a three out of ten, the pill works, I just feel meh in the mornings.
lines.en: Nausea's about a three out of ten, the pill works, I just feel meh in the mornings.

lines.text: So tired today, the walk took everything out of me, but I took a nap and I'm good.
lines.en: So tired today, the walk took everything out of me, but I took a nap and I'm good.

lines.text: If my sister makes me eat one more kale chip I'm gonna murder her.
lines.en: If my sister makes me eat one more kale chip I'm gonna murder her.

lines.text: The copay is annoying, forty bucks, but I paid it, no problem.
lines.en: The copay is annoying, forty bucks, but I paid it, no problem.

lines.text: My neighbor fainted at church yesterday, the ambulance came, she's okay now.
lines.en: My neighbor fainted at church yesterday, the ambulance came, she's okay now.

lines.text: My landlord almost evicted me in March but the social worker got me rental aid and it's all sorted.
lines.en: My landlord almost evicted me in March but the social worker got me rental aid and it's all sorted.

lines.text: Little nosebleed this morning, like two drops. The oncologist said that's normal with the dry air and the nose spray.
lines.en: Little nosebleed this morning, like two drops. The oncologist said that's normal with the dry air and the nose spray.

lines.text: I could just die of embarrassment, I called the nurse by the wrong name again.
lines.en: I could just die of embarrassment, I called the nurse by the wrong name again.

lines.text: My chest felt tight yesterday, I called the nurse line, they said reflux, I took the antacid and it's gone.
lines.en: My chest felt tight yesterday, I called the nurse line, they said reflux, I took the antacid and it's gone.

lines.text: my hare is falling out in clumps but my wig came in so i look good lol
lines.en: my hare is falling out in clumps but my wig came in so i look good lol

lines.text: I walked three times this week and slept eight hours. Feeling good.
lines.en: I walked three times this week and slept eight hours. Feeling good.

lines.text: Rough week with the grandkids, my back hurts from lifting them, nothing new, I do my stretches.
lines.en: Rough week with the grandkids, my back hurts from lifting them, nothing new, I do my stretches.

lines.text: My mom is in hospice, we're all sad, but she's comfortable and the family is with her.
lines.en: My mom is in hospice, we're all sad, but she's comfortable and the family is with her.

lines.text: I was in the hospital in June with an infection, all done, the follow-up was fine.
lines.en: I was in the hospital in June with an infection, all done, the follow-up was fine.

lines.text: That chemo room is freezing, I'm gonna die of cold, so I bring my blanket.
lines.en: That chemo room is freezing, I'm gonna die of cold, so I bring my blanket.

lines.text: Estos ejercicios me están matando, mija, pero ahí voy.
lines.en: These exercises are killing me, dear, but I'm going.

lines.text: Me muero de la risa con las cosas que dice mi nieto.
lines.en: I die laughing at the things my grandson says.

lines.text: Tuve fiebre el martes pero fui a emergencias, me dieron antibiótico y no ha vuelto.
lines.en: I had a fever Tuesday but went to the ER, they gave antibiotics, and it hasn't returned.

lines.text: Me duele un poquito la boca por la quimio, me enjuago con bicarbonato como me dijo la enfermera.
lines.en: My mouth is a little sore from chemo, I rinse with baking soda as the nurse said.

lines.text: Mi esposo está con gripe y tos, lo llevo hoy al médico.
lines.en: My husband has the flu and a cough, I'm taking him to the doctor today.

lines.text: Estoy un poco triste hoy, extrañando a mi mamá en Cuba, pero se me pasa.
lines.en: A bit sad today, missing my mom in Cuba, but it passes.

lines.text: Los precios del súper están por las nubes, qué barbaridad, pero uno se las arregla.
lines.en: Supermarket prices are sky-high, but one manages.

lines.text: Hace dos años pensé cosas feas, pero con la terapia estoy bien, sigo con mi psicóloga cada semana.
lines.en: Two years ago I had dark thoughts, but with therapy I'm fine, still see my psychologist weekly.

lines.text: Qué calor, me estoy asando viva, ya no aguanto este verano.
lines.en: So hot, I'm roasting alive, can't stand this summer.

lines.text: Se me cayó el pelo, pero ya compré la peluca y me veo divina.
lines.en: My hair fell out, but I bought the wig and look fabulous.

lines.text: Anoche vomité una vez por la comida pesada, hoy desayuné normal.
lines.en: Last night I vomited once from heavy food, today I ate breakfast normally.

lines.text: Estoy cansadísima hoy, pero dormí una siesta y ya.
lines.en: I'm exhausted today, but I took a nap and I'm fine.

lines.text: Esta dieta me tiene muerta de hambre, quiero un cafecito con pastelito y no puedo.
lines.en: This diet has me starving, I want a cafecito with a pastelito and can't.

lines.text: La vecina se desmayó ayer en la tienda pero vino la ambulancia y está bien.
lines.en: The neighbor fainted yesterday in the store but the ambulance came and she's fine.

lines.text: Casi me desalojan en marzo, pero la trabajadora social me consiguió la ayuda y ya está pagado.
lines.en: They almost evicted me in March, but the social worker got me help and it's paid.

lines.text: La medicina es cara, 30 dólares de copago, pero la pagué.
lines.en: Medicine is expensive, $30 copay, but I paid it.

lines.text: Mañana tengo cita y me muero de nervios, pero iré.
lines.en: I have an appointment tomorrow and I'm dying of nerves, but I'll go.

lines.text: estube con la presion alta pero me la tome y ya esta normal, ablé con la enfermera
lines.en: My pressure was high but I took it and it's normal now, I spoke with the nurse.

lines.text: Tuve un dolor de pecho el domingo, llamé a la línea de enfermeras, era reflujo, me dieron antiácido y se quitó.
lines.en: Chest pain Sunday, called the nurse line, it was reflux, antacid and it went away.

lines.text: Mi hija me tiene harta con que coma verduras, la voy a matar.
lines.en: My daughter has me fed up with eating vegetables, I'll kill her.

lines.text: Dormí fatal, el insomnio de siempre por la prednisona, ya lo hablé con el médico.
lines.en: Slept terribly, the usual insomnia from prednisone, already discussed with the doctor.

lines.text: Mi suegro está en cuidados paliativos, estamos tristes pero tranquilos.
lines.en: My father-in-law is in palliative care, we're sad but calm.

lines.text: Caminé tres veces esta semana y comí bien. Todo bien.
lines.en: I walked three times this week and ate well. All good.

lines.text: Me quedé sin gasolina pero mi yerno vino y me llevó, ya está resuelto.
lines.en: I ran out of gas but my son-in-law came and took me, it's resolved.

lines.text: Rejim sa a ap touye m, m anvi manje diri ak sòs pwa.
lines.en: This diet is killing me, I want rice and bean sauce.

lines.text: M ap mouri ri ak istwa pitit gason m nan.
lines.en: I'm dying of laughter at my son's story.

lines.text: M te gen lafyèv madi, mwen te ale lopital, yo ban m antibyotik, depi lè sa m pa gen lafyèv ankò.
lines.en: I had fever Tuesday, went to hospital, got antibiotics, no fever since.

lines.text: Dwèt mwen angoudi lè fè frèt, doktè a konn sa, se menm bagay ak dènye fwa.
lines.en: My fingers go numb in the cold, the doctor knows, same as last time.

lines.text: Mari m gen tous ak lafyèv, m ap mennen li kay doktè jodi a.
lines.en: My husband has cough and fever, I'm taking him to the doctor today.

lines.text: M tris yon ti kras semèn sa a, manman m manke m, men sa ap pase.
lines.en: A bit sad this week, I miss my mother, but it will pass.

lines.text: Pri manje a chè anpil, men m jere, m jwenn sa m bezwen.
lines.en: Food prices are very high, but I manage, I get what I need.

lines.text: Ane pase m te nan yon move moman, men depi m ap wè konseye a chak semèn, m pa santi sa ankò.
lines.en: Last year I was in a bad place, but since seeing the counselor weekly I don't feel it anymore.

lines.text: M fatige anpil jodi a, m dòmi yon ti som epi m byen.
lines.en: Very tired today, I slept a little and I'm fine.

lines.text: Chalè a ap kwit mwen, m pral fonn!
lines.en: The heat is cooking me, I'm going to melt!

lines.text: Mwen te vomi samdi paske manje a te twòp, kounye a m ap manje nòmal.
lines.en: I vomited Saturday because I ate too much, now I eat normally.

lines.text: Cheve m ap tonbe men m gen perik mwen, m gen bèl bagay.
lines.en: My hair is falling out but I have my wig, I look nice.

lines.text: Vwazin mwen tonbe nan legliz yè, anbilans vini, li byen kounye a.
lines.en: My neighbor fell at church yesterday, ambulance came, she's well now.

lines.text: Mwen te prèske pèdi kay la nan mas, men travayè sosyal la jwenn èd e tout bagay peye.
lines.en: I almost lost the house in March, but the social worker found help and all is paid.

lines.text: Kopeman an chè, trant dola, men m peye l.
lines.en: The copay is steep, thirty dollars, but I paid it.

lines.text: Pa gen anyen ki gen gou ankò, men doktè a di se chimyo a, li konnen.
lines.en: Nothing tastes like anything now, but the doctor says it's the chemo, he knows.

lines.text: tansyon m te wo men m pran li e l nomal kounye a, m pale ak enfimyè a
lines.en: My pressure was high but I took it and it's normal now, I spoke with the nurse.

lines.text: Mwen mouri wont, m rele enfimyè a ak move non ankò.
lines.en: I'm dying of shame, I called the nurse by the wrong name again.

lines.text: Pitit fi m ap fè m manje legim, m pral touye l!
lines.en: My daughter is making me eat vegetables, I'll kill her!

lines.text: Doulè pwatrin mwen te la dimanch, m rele liy enfimyè a, se te asid, m pran antasid, li pase.
lines.en: Chest pain Sunday, called the nurse line, it was acid, took antacid, it passed.

lines.text: Mwen mache twa fwa semèn sa a, m manje byen. Tout bon.
lines.en: I walked three times this week and ate well. All good.

lines.text: Manman madanm mwen nan ospis, nou tris, men li alèz.
lines.en: My wife's mother is in hospice, we're sad, but she is comfortable.

lines.text: Nen m senyen yon ti jan maten an, de gout, se lè sèk la, doktè a di se nòmal.
lines.en: My nose bled a little this morning, two drops, the dry season, doctor says it's normal.

lines.text: Mwen te nan lopital nan jen pou yon enfeksyon, tout bagay fini, swivi a te bon.
lines.en: I was in hospital in June for an infection, all finished, follow-up was good.
